senses.gloss: तिमिर- + घूर्ण तिमिर- + घूर्ण (corr. perhaps तिमिरे-), adj. staggering in dimness, Cāṇ. 70, Berl. Monatsb. [] 1864, 411.

तिम् तिम्, i. 4, Par. To become wet, Hit. 79, 5 Seramp.
 --Ptcple. of the pf. pass. तिमित, Unmoved, Rām. 5, 1, 26.
 --Cf. स्तिम्.

तिमि तिम् + इ, m.
 1. A large fish, MBh. 1, 1222.
 2. A whale, Ragh. 13, 10.
 3. A fish in general, Kathās. 5, 24.

तिमिंगिल तिमिंगिल, i. e. तिमि + म् -2 गॄ + अ, m.
 1. A large fabulous fish, MBh. 1, 1208.
 2. The name of a people and their prince, MBh. 2, 1172.
 --Comp.
तिमि- + तिमिंगिल तिमि- + तिमिंगिल, m. a large fabulous fish, MBh. 3, 12081.

तिमिर तिमिर (akin to तमस्, perhaps for original तम् + इर),
 I. adj., f. रा, Dark, Rām. 6, 16, 104.
 II. m. and n.
 1. Darkness, Rām. 2, 28, 18.
 2. A class of diseases of the eye, Suśr. 1, 32, 4.
 3. A certain plant, Varāh. Bṛh. S. 54, 11.
 III. n. The name of a town, Rām. 4, 40, 26.
 --Comp.
तिमीर तिमीर, m. A certain tree, Rām. 3, 21, 19.
तिमिरय तिमिरय, a denomin. [] derived from the last, Par. To darken, Hit. 103, 10.
तिमिश तिमिश, probably to be corrected to तिनिश, Rām. 2, 94, 8.
तिमि- + ध्वज तिमि- + ध्वज, epithet of the demon Śambara, Rām. 2, 8, 12 Gorr.
